passive.name: More Sparkles!
passive.desc: Zoe's next basic attack after casting a spell deals bonus magic damage.

spells.name: Paddle Star!
spells.desc: Zoe fires a missile that she can redirect in flight. Deals more damage the longer it flies in a straight line.

spells.name: Spell Thief
spells.desc: Zoe can pick up the remnants of enemy summoner spell and active item casts and cast them once herself. Whenever she casts a summoner spell, she gains 3 missiles that fire at the nearest target.

spells.name: Sleepy Trouble Bubble
spells.desc: Causes the target to become drowsy, then fall asleep. While asleep, the target's Magic Resist is reduced. The first source of damage that breaks the sleep is doubled, up to a cap.

spells.name: Portal Jump
spells.desc: Blink to a nearby position for 1 second. Then blink back.
